Ajax takes up to three turns each round. He can't take turns consecutively. Additionally, he can use three [triggered actions](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) in a round while he isn't [dazed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/dazed).

While the target is marked this way, Ajax gains an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on power rolls against them, and whenever the target uses a [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) involving their mark on Ajax, he can make a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) against them.
